llm_reasoning: Fluid intelligence is primarily associated with the frontoparietal network, which includes the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC), inferior frontal gyrus (IFG), and the intraparietal sulcus (IPS). The default mode network (DMN) and cerebellar loops also play roles, particularly in the integration of information and error correction. The thalamus and basal ganglia contribute to cognitive control and working memory processes.
